scope: real application PostgreSQL/transaction/outbox integration; no Express/Zod or repository execution
checks: application migration applies and is idempotent
business record and outbox roll back atomically
six concurrent duplicate requests produce one business record/outbox event
invalid transition rejected and successful transition audited once
foreign keys, outcome enum and repeat ceiling enforced by PostgreSQL
concurrent run reservations cannot create two unfinished runs
finalizing cancellation acknowledges only resolved or never-started runs
both report formats and terminal transition commit or roll back together
actual BullMQ enqueue survives lost acknowledgement without duplicate job
application reports and queue metadata survive immediate DB shutdown/recovery
terminal deletion cascades application evidence metadata
